userPrompt: What is the tallest building in the world?
responseText:
**Burj Khalifa** in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, is the tallest building in the world.

- Height: 828 meters (2,717 feet)
- Floors: 163
- Completed: 2010

It has held the title since 2010 and remains taller than any other completed building (including Merdeka 118 in Kuala Lumpur at 678.9 m).
